GgAggregateBucket.description:
One bucket of an aggregate result — the runs that share a group-by key, with the
metrics aggregated over them.

key.description:
The bucket's composite key — one component per query
[`group_by`](GgAggregateQuery::group_by) facet, in the same order. Empty for the
single grand-total bucket of an ungrouped query.

metrics.description: The aggregated metrics, one per requested [`GgMetricSpec`], in request order.

n.description: How many runs fell into this bucket.

stateDistribution.description:
The bucket's terminal-state distribution, in [`RunState::ALL`] order, omitting
states with no runs.

GgBucketKeyPart.description:
One component of a bucket's composite key: the [facet](GgFacet) it groups on and
the value the bucket's runs share (`None` = the runs share the *absence* of the
facet).

facet.description: The facet this key component groups on.

value.description: The shared value, or `None` when the bucket's runs all lack the facet.

GgMetricValue.description: The aggregated value of one [requested metric](GgMetricSpec) in one bucket.

contributing.description: How many of the bucket's runs contributed a value to this figure (`<= n`).

metric.description: The metric this value is for.

value.description:
The aggregated figure, or `None` when no run in the bucket carried the metric
(so a whole column can be absent even though the bucket has runs).

GgStateCount.description: One `(state, count)` entry of a bucket's terminal-state distribution.

count.description: How many of the bucket's runs ended in it.

description:
The response to a [`GgAggregateQuery`]: the buckets, plus the total runs the
filters matched.

buckets.description: The buckets, largest first (ties broken by key for determinism).

totalRuns.description: How many gg runs matched the query's filters (the sum of every bucket's `n`).

title: GgAggregateResponse
